   252→function evictOldestCacheEntries(count: number = 1): number {
   253→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 0
   254→
   255→  try {
   256→    // Collect all flat-lay cache entries with their timestamps
   257→    const cacheEntries: Array<{ key: string; timestamp: number }> = []
   258→
   259→    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {

   263→          const cached = localStorage.getItem(key)
   264→          if (cached) {
   265→            const parsed: CachedImage = JSON.parse(cached)
   266→            cacheEntries.push({ key, timestamp: parsed.timestamp })
   267→          }

   269→          // Corrupted entry, add with timestamp 0 to prioritize removal
   270→          cacheEntries.push({ key, timestamp: 0 })
   271→        }
   272→      }
   273→    }

   275→    if (cacheEntries.length === 0) {
   276→      return 0

   278→
   279→    // Sort by timestamp (oldest first)
   280→    cacheEntries.sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp)
   281→
   282→    // Remove the specified number of oldest entries
   283→    const toEvict = Math.min(count, cacheEntries.length)
   284→    let evicted = 0

   293→      }

   481→  const [productReplacements, setProductReplacements] = useState<Map<string, Product>>(new Map())
   482→  const [effectiveProducts, setEffectiveProducts] = useState<Product[]>(items)
   483→
   484→  // Track if generation has been attempted for this outfit
   485→  const hasAttemptedRef = useRef(false)
   486→  // Track if component is mounted
   487→  const isMountedRef = useRef(true)
   488→  // Track the current outfitId for cleanup
   489→  const currentOutfitIdRef = useRef(outfitId)
   490→
   491→  // Reset state when outfitId changes
   492→  useEffect(() => {
   493→    if (currentOutfitIdRef.current !== outfitId) {

   495→      removeFromQueue(currentOutfitIdRef.current)
   496→
   497→      // Check new outfit's cache
   498→      const cached = getCachedImage(outfitId)
   499→      if (cached) {
   500→        setFlatLayImageBase64(cached)
   501→        setIsFromCache(true)
   502→        hasAttemptedRef.current = true
   503→      } else {
   504→        setFlatLayImageBase64(undefined)
   505→        setIsFromCache(false)
   506→        hasAttemptedRef.current = false
   507→      }
   508→
   509→      setIsGenerating(false)
   510→      setIsQueued(false)
   511→      setQueuePosition(0)
   512→      setError(undefined)
   513→      currentOutfitIdRef.current = outfitId
   514→    }
   515→  }, [outfitId])
   516→
   517→  // Update queue position periodically when queued
   518→  useEffect(() => {
   519→    if (!isQueued) return
   520→
   521→    const interval = setInterval(() => {
   522→      const pos = getQueuePosition(outfitId)
   523→      if (isMountedRef.current) {
   524→        setQueuePosition(pos)
   525→        if (pos === 0) {

   527→          setIsQueued(false)
   528→        }
   529→      }
   530→    }, 500)
   531→
   532→    return () => clearInterval(interval)
   533→  }, [isQueued, outfitId])
   534→
   535→  // Cleanup on unmount
   536→  useEffect(() => {
   537→    isMountedRef.current = true
   538→    return () => {
   539→      isMountedRef.current = false
   540→      // Remove from queue on unmount
   541→      removeFromQueue(outfitId)
   542→    }
   543→  }, [outfitId])
   544→

   546→   * Internal function to perform the actual generation
   547→   */
   548→  const performGeneration = useCallback(async () => {
   549→    if (!isMountedRef.current) return
   550→
   551→    // Mark as generating, not queued
   552→    setIsQueued(false)
   553→    setQueuePosition(0)
   554→    setIsGenerating(true)
   555→    setError(undefined)
   556→    hasAttemptedRef.current = true
   557→    currentGenerations++
   558→
   559→    // Transform products to flat-lay items with visual consistency validation
   560→    // Pass allProducts to enable automatic replacement of inconsistent items
   561→    const transformResult = transformToFlatLayItems(items, true, allProducts)
   562→
   563→    // Update replacement state
   564→    setProductReplacements(transformResult.replacements)
   565→    setEffectiveProducts(transformResult.effectiveProducts)
   566→
   567→    // Notify parent component of replacements if callback provided
   568→    if (transformResult.replacements.size > 0 && onProductsReplaced) {
   569→      onProductsReplaced(transformResult.replacements, transformResult.effectiveProducts)
   570→    }
   571→
   572→    // Log visual consistency warnings
   573→    if (transformResult.hasInconsistentItems && transformResult.excludedSkus.length > 0) {
   574→      console.warn(
   575→        '[useFlatLayGeneration] Some visual consistency issues remain after replacement attempts. ' +
   576→        'Flat-lay image may not perfectly match product thumbnails for these items:',
   577→        transformResult.excludedSkus
   578→      )
   579→    }

   582→    const flatLayItems = transformResult.items

   585→    const maxRetries = 1

   587→

   589→      try {
   590→        if (attempt > 0) {

   592→          const delay = Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000
   593→          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay))
   594→        }
   595→
   596→        const response = await fetch('/api/generate-image', {
   597→          method: 'POST',
   598→          headers: {
   599→            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   600→          },
   601→          body: JSON.stringify({
   602→            generationType: 'flat-lay',
   603→            flatLayItems,
   604→            occasionContext,
   605→          }),
   606→        })
   607→
   608→        const result: ImageGenerationResponse = await response.json()
   609→
   610→        if (!isMountedRef.current) {
   611→          currentGenerations--
   612→          processQueue() // Allow next in queue to proceed
   613→          return
   614→        }
   615→
   616→        if (result.success && result.imageBase64) {
   617→          setFlatLayImageBase64(result.imageBase64)
   618→          setIsFromCache(false)
   619→          setError(undefined)

   623→          setIsGenerating(false)

   625→          return
   626→        } else {
   627→          lastError = result.message || result.error || 'Generation failed'
   628→        }
   629→      } catch (err) {
   630→        console.error('[useFlatLayGeneration] API error:', err)
   631→        lastError = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Network error'
   632→      }
   633→    }
   634→
   635→    // All retries failed
   636→    if (isMountedRef.current) {
   637→      setError(lastError)
   638→      setIsGenerating(false)
   639→    }
   640→    currentGenerations--
   641→    processQueue() // Process next in queue even on failure
   642→  }, [outfitId, items, occasionContext, allProducts, onProductsReplaced])

   644→  /**
   645→   * Generate flat-lay image via API

   682→    isQueued,
   683→    queuePosition,
   684→    flatLayImageBase64,
   685→    error,

   693→/**
   694→ * Hook for using Intersection Observer to trigger lazy generation
   695→ */
   696→export function useIntersectionObserver(
   697→  callback: () => void,
   698→  options?: IntersectionObserverInit
   699→): React.RefCallback<HTMLElement> {
   700→  const observerRef = useRef<IntersectionObserver | null>(null)
   701→  const hasTriggeredRef = useRef(false)
   702→
   703→  const setRef = useCallback(
   704→    (element: HTMLElement | null) => {
   705→      // Disconnect previous observer
   706→      if (observerRef.current) {
   707→        observerRef.current.disconnect()
   708→        observerRef.current = null
   709→      }
   710→
   711→      // Skip if already triggered or no element
   712→      if (hasTriggeredRef.current || !element) {
   713→        return
   714→      }
   715→
   716→      observerRef.current = new IntersectionObserver(
   717→        (entries) => {
   718→          const [entry] = entries
   719→          if (entry?.isIntersecting && !hasTriggeredRef.current) {
   720→            hasTriggeredRef.current = true
   721→            callback()
   722→            // Disconnect after triggering
   723→            observerRef.current?.disconnect()
   724→          }
   725→        },
   726→        {
   727→          threshold: 0.1, // Trigger when 10% visible
   728→          ...options,
   729→        }
   730→      )
   731→
   732→      observerRef.current.observe(element)
   733→    },
   734→    [callback, options]
   735→  )
   736→
   737→  // Cleanup on unmount
   738→  useEffect(() => {
   739→    return () => {
   740→      observerRef.current?.disconnect()
   741→    }
   742→  }, [])
   743→
   744→  return setRef
   745→}

   397→/**
   398→ * Calculate similarity score between two products for replacement ranking

   403→export function getSimilarityScore(original: Product, candidate: Product): number {
   404→  let score = 0

   406→  // Category match (30 points)
   407→  const origCategory = (original.subCategory || original.category || '').toLowerCase()
   408→  const candCategory = (candidate.subCategory || candidate.category || '').toLowerCase()
   409→  if (origCategory === candCategory) {
   410→    score += 30
   411→  } else if (origCategory.includes(candCategory) || candCategory.includes(origCategory)) {
   412→    score += 15
   413→  }
   414→
   415→  // Price proximity (25 points)
   416→  // Perfect match at same price, decreasing as price difference grows
   417→  const priceDiff = Math.abs(original.price - candidate.price)
   418→  const priceRatio = priceDiff / original.price
   419→  if (priceRatio <= 0.1) {
   420→    score += 25 // Within 10% of original price
   421→  } else if (priceRatio <= 0.2) {
   422→    score += 20
   423→  } else if (priceRatio <= 0.3) {
   424→    score += 15
   425→  } else if (priceRatio <= 0.5) {
   426→    score += 5
   427→  }
   428→
   429→  // Occasion overlap (20 points)
   430→  const origOccasions = original.occasion || []
   431→  const candOccasions = candidate.occasion || []
   432→  if (origOccasions.length > 0 && candOccasions.length > 0) {
   433→    const overlap = origOccasions.filter(o => candOccasions.includes(o)).length
   434→    score += Math.min(20, overlap * 10)
   435→  } else if (origOccasions.length === 0 && candOccasions.length === 0) {
   436→    score += 10 // Both have no occasion specified, neutral match
   437→  }
   438→
   439→  // Color compatibility (15 points)
   440→  const origColors = original.colors || []
   441→  const candColors = candidate.colors || []
   442→  if (origColors.length > 0 && candColors.length > 0) {
   443→    const colorMatch = origColors.some(c => candColors.includes(c))
   444→    if (colorMatch) score += 15
   445→  }
   446→
   447→  // Brand consistency (10 points)
   448→  if (original.brand && candidate.brand && original.brand.toLowerCase() === candidate.brand.toLowerCase()) {
   449→    score += 10
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return score
   453→}
